# Input

Use a paired RNA+ATAC Seurat object with broad cell-type metadata, RNA PCA or Harmony, ATAC LSI, and genome-compatible peaks.

```r
gem <- rc_prepare_gem(
  species = "human",
  version = "2.0.0",
  source = "bundled"
)

medium_scenarios <- rc_make_medium_scenarios(
  gem = gem,
  scenario = "normal_human_plasma",
  species = "human"
)
```

When the workflow creates the medium automatically, human models use `normal_human_plasma` and mouse models use `mouse_plasma`.

# One-shot run

```r
result <- rc_run_regcompass_one_shot(
  object = A,
  outdir = "RegCompass_result",
  genome = BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38,
  species = "human",
  gem = gem,
  medium_scenarios = medium_scenarios,
  condition_col = "condition",
  celltype_col = "cell_type",
  pando_args = list(
    pando_infer_args = list(
      tf_cor = 0.05,
      peak_cor = 0.05,
      adjust_method = "BH",
      padj_threshold = 0.05,
      rank_action = "mark",
      min_residual_df = 1L,
      reference_condition = "Control"
    )
  ),
  workers = 10L
)
```

For multi-condition cell types, the production conditional GRN uses E-star with fixed `z = 0.25` on one frozen exact `(target, TF, peak)` dictionary. E-star supplies the continuous condition-specific production coefficients and retains Q-orthogonal shared/deviation, boundary and penalty-fusion metadata. Formal topology inference is separate from that selected structure: Pando fits the same target-specific dictionary independently within each condition without fusion, constructs one exact-edge omnibus P value across the conditions in which that coefficient is estimable, and applies BH once across all estimable exact edges in the broad cell type. The supported exact-edge topology is then common to every condition, while each condition retains its own continuous E-star `penalty_effect`.

`reference_condition` is the predefined experimental reference used only by the K-condition E-star contrast-tree geometry; it is not an inference tuning or sensitivity parameter. If omitted, the first retained condition is used and recorded. Conditional ridge-CV controls, fusion-ratio controls, and alternative `z` values are not part of this production API. Conditional full-data target R-squared remains diagnostic only.

The main stage-specific configuration bundles are `pando_args`, `metacell_args`, `meta_module_args`, `layer1_args`, and `layer2_args`. `model_mode = "meta_module_gem"` uses CORDA2 by default. Full parameter definitions are maintained in the corresponding Rd help pages.

# Restartable workflow

The same workflow can be run stage by stage with:

```r
step1 <- rc_regcompass_step_grn(...)
step2 <- rc_regcompass_step_metacells(..., grn = step1)
step3 <- rc_regcompass_step_meta_modules(grn = step1, metacells = step2, ...)
step4 <- rc_regcompass_step_layer1(grn = step1, metacells = step2, meta_modules = step3, ...)
step5 <- rc_regcompass_step_layer2(layer1 = step4, meta_modules = step3, ...)
result <- rc_regcompass_step_results(grn = step1, metacells = step2, meta_modules = step3, layer1 = step4, layer2 = step5, ...)
```
